risks.title: Commodity price volatility
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K, strong language on direct impact on revenues and profitability. Presented as a recurring risk with high intensity, critical for the mining sector.

risks.title: Newcrest integration
risks.score_rationale: Flagged as a major risk in the 10-K, with explicit mention of high costs and operational risks. Alarming language on delays, cost overruns, and cultural integration.

risks.title: Stringent environmental regulations
risks.score_rationale: Prominent placement in the document, with mention of rising rehabilitation costs. Serious tone regarding future obligations and potential fines.

risks.title: Geopolitical risks in operating regions
risks.score_rationale: Flagged in multiple sections, with mention of high-risk countries such as the DRC or South America. Cautious language on expropriations and political instability.

risks.title: Legal and regulatory proceedings
risks.score_rationale: Recurring mention of ongoing litigation, particularly in Australia (Fair Work). Precise language on provisions and financial risks.

risks.title: Regulatory changes in Ghana
risks.score_rationale: New and material risk following the expiration of the revised investment agreement on December 31, 2025. Increase in income tax from 32.5% to 35%, new 3% gross revenue tax, and proposed variable royalties from 5% to 12% linked to gold prices.

risks.title: Disagreement within the Nevada Gold Mines joint venture
risks.score_rationale: Emerging risk reported in January-February 2026. Newmont has identified evidence of mismanagement and diversion of resources by operator Barrick to its own properties, leading to the exercise of contractual audit rights.

risks.title: Debt and refinancing
risks.score_rationale: Presented in financial risks, with mention of refinancing and interest costs. Less central than others, but closely monitored.

risks.title: Shortage of key skills
risks.score_rationale: Discreet but recurring mention of difficulty attracting and retaining qualified personnel. Measured language, but structural risk.

ai_positioning.summary: No significant mention of artificial intelligence was found in the 10-K filing.
